name: video-companion-extension
description: 增强网页视频播放体验 - 画中画、全屏、倍速控制等

scripts.build:zip: npm run build && cd dist && zip -r ../video-companion-extension.zip . && cd ..
scripts.website:prepare: mkdir -p website/snapshots website/assets/images && cp docs/snapshots/*.png website/snapshots/ && cp public/icons/icon48.png website/assets/images/favicon-48.png && cp public/icons/icon16.png website/assets/images/favicon-16.png && node scripts/sync-website-version.mjs
